actions: Knowledge is concentrated in one person: name a backup maintainer and record them in MAINTAINER.md.
List current maintainers, their responsibilities and a backup in MAINTAINER.md.
Add a CODEOWNERS file so review responsibility is explicit and survives turnover.
Add CONTRIBUTING.md explaining how changes are proposed, reviewed and merged.
Describe the main components and how they fit together in ARCHITECTURE.md.
Write down how a release is cut and published (RELEASE.md).
Write down how to set up a development environment and run the tests (DEVELOPMENT.md or a section in CONTRIBUTING.md).
Add CONTINUITY.md: project status, who can take over, and which accounts and credentials a successor needs.
Automate publishing in CI so releasing does not depend on one person's machine and credentials.
Keep a changelog so a successor can see what changed between releases.
Configure Dependabot or Renovate so dependency updates don't rely on one person noticing.
